quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): operating revenue RMB 5,270,259,670.62, up 26.72% from RMB 4,158,978,409.78; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 610,887,824.39, up 54.97%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 577,036,627.57 (+67.51%); operating cash flow RMB 911,459,286.56 (+85.53%). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 943,431,003.63, Q2 RMB 1,219,382,185.30, Q3 RMB 1,445,823,636.54, Q4 RMB 1,661,622,845.15; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 111,053,036.94, Q2 RMB 144,296,317.51, Q3 RMB 190,475,963.01, Q4 RMB 165,062,506.93. Company: data-center growth accelerated, and new-energy storage orders rose quickly on recovering European demand and strong emerging-market demand

FY2025 data-center industry revenue RMB 3,130,857,497.50, up 14.18%, 59.40% of revenue, gross margin 34.44%; within it smart power and data-center products RMB 2,954,501,002.23 (+13.76%, gross margin 34.53%), which the MD&A describes as data-center core business revenue of RMB 29.55 hundred million with growth accelerating. Data-center product volumes: sales 2,379,897 sets (-3.64%), output 2,347,078 sets (-7.50%). The company notes customer demand for mid/high-power products grew especially markedly as data-center per-unit power density keeps rising

FY2025 new-energy industry revenue RMB 2,087,424,561.62, up 51.39%, gross margin 19.42%; PV-storage-charging products and systems RMB 2,068,916,309.55 (+52.01%, gross margin 19.36%); new-energy product sales 292,425 sets (+52.04%). quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (annual report): data centers are its core business, with overseas business now over 50%; it is focusing on core products for AIDC including minimalist UPS, liquid-cooling CDUs and systems, new HVDC and SST solid-state transformers to match the power needs of future hyperscale intelligent-computing centers, and offering prefabricated products that integrate core equipment in containers (steel frame plus prefabricated modules) as customers demand faster delivery. In 2025 it delivered data-center projects including the China Construction Bank Gui'an data center, ICBC's 2024 high-power UPS project, China Telecom Cloud Computing Inner Mongolia's 2025 data-center project, the Inner Mongolia Mobile data park and a core leading internet cloud company's data center
